implementation.reasoning: Deleting the current user in DELETE /api/v1/users/me will also delete their related items because the User.items relationship is configured with cascade='all, delete-orphan'. The admin credentials in the requirement are initialized in init_db(), and afterward GET /api/v1/items/{item_id} returns 404 'Item not found' once the cascaded item deletion has occurred.
